title: IKEA desk - good for a small dorm
description: Demo listing (fictional): Two years old, a few marks on the top. Legs come off for moving. Selling because my new room has a desk.

title: Wooden chair for a dorm desk
description: Demo listing (fictional): Solid chair with a fabric seat. Cushion has some wear. Fits under a standard dorm desk. Can meet after afternoon classes.

title: All-in-one computer with keyboard
description: Demo listing (fictional): Older desktop for documents and web browsing. Keyboard and power cable included. You can check it running at pickup.

title: Wired over-ear headphones
description: Demo listing (fictional): Used for studying in the library. Pads have some wear. Cable included; no Bluetooth.

title: Intro textbooks and graph paper bundle
description: Demo listing (fictional): Used introductory course books with pencil notes. Message for editions before buying; not every class uses these.

title: Commuter bike with lock
description: Demo listing (fictional): Used around campus. Brakes work; rear tire could use air. Frame is best for someone around 5 ft 7 to 5 ft 10.

title: Everyday backpack, 15-inch laptop sleeve
description: Demo listing (fictional): Dark backpack with a padded sleeve. Zipper works; small stain on the bottom. Washed before pickup.

title: Reading lamp for a desk or bedside table
description: Demo listing (fictional): Warm light, working switch. Includes LED bulb. Small scuff on the base.

title: Small bookshelf - three shelves
description: Demo listing (fictional): Fits next to a dorm desk. A little wobble on uneven floors. Bring a friend to carry it.

title: Used laptop for browsing and notes
description: Demo listing (fictional): Good for documents and web browsing, not gaming. Battery lasts about two hours. Charger included; can show it running at pickup.

title: Spare desktop computer for notes
description: Demo listing (fictional): Older all-in-one computer, used for notes. Power cable and keyboard included. Good for a basic dorm setup.

title: Paperback reading bundle
description: Demo listing (fictional): Five used paperbacks with worn covers. Clearing space before moving; sold together.
